subject: Secure offline installer & compliance artifacts for OTLP bridge
messages:
From: Priya Shah <pshah@grafana.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: mike.allen@datadoghq.com
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: air-gapped installer + certification evidence for OTLP bridge

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the quick chat at Observability Summit. As we discussed, several enterprise customers are asking for an air-gapped/offline distribution of the OTLP bridge that integrates Redwood’s inference telemetry with Grafana Cloud. Before we proceed to pilot, our security and procurement teams need:

- A signed installer tarball (sha256) and a deterministic build manifest
- A short install guide for offline environments (no outbound connectivity)
- Evidence for secure build/signing: KMS signing process, SBOM, and any SOC2 or SOC2-like attestations you can share
- Guidance on ephemeral license keys or offline activation model (valid for 30/90 days)

I’ve attached Grafana’s compliance checklist to help scope the ask. Can your engineering/security team confirm whether you can provide these artifacts, and an estimated timeline for a first drop? If useful, we can schedule a 30-min technical alignment this week.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Shah
Partner Security Lead, Grafana
pshah@grafana.com

Attachments: grafana_compliance_checklist.pdf
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@grafana.com>
Cc: mike.allen@datadoghq.com
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: air-gapped installer + certification evidence for OTLP bridge

Hi Priya,

Appreciate the clear list — this is doable. High-level plan we can commit to for a pilot:

1) Deliverables for pilot (within 7 business days):
   - Signed installer tarball (rdw_signed_installer_v1.tar.gz) + sha256 manifest
   - Offline install guide (rdw_offline_install_v1.md) with preflight checks and systemd/unit examples
   - SBOM (CycloneDX) + build manifest with deterministic build notes

2) Security notes:
   - We will sign the installer with our KMS-backed signing key and provide a detached .sig file.
   - We can provide a short write-up of our build pipeline (redacted where necessary) and a SOC2 artifact summary. Full SOC2 report requires an NDA / MSA-level exchange.

3) Licensing/activation:
   - We propose an ephemeral license model for air-gapped customers: a signed JSON blob exchanged via the customer, validated locally by the installer. We’ll supply tooling to mint short-lived keys (30/90 days).

I’ve attached an internal draft “rdw_airgap_plan_v1.docx” with the proposed steps and an initial checklist. Internal owners: Ben Carter (packaging/ops) and Laura Bennett (partner PM) will lead the work. Ben — can you confirm build/signing approach and ETA? Laura — can you confirm if partner success needs any specific onboarding artifacts beyond what’s listed?

Happy to jump on a tech call; suggest Wed 10–11am PT.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
